Interface AlgoAlertStateJpaRepository

All Superinterfaces:
org.springframework.data.repository.CrudRepository<AlgoAlertState, Integer>, org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<AlgoAlertState, Integer>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListCrudRepository<AlgoAlertState, Integer>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListPagingAndSortingRepository<AlgoAlertState, Integer>, org.springframework.data.repository.PagingAndSortingRepository<AlgoAlertState, Integer>, org.springframework.data.repository.query.QueryByExampleExecutor<AlgoAlertState>, org.springframework.data.repository.Repository<AlgoAlertState, Integer>
public interface AlgoAlertStateJpaRepository extends org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<AlgoAlertState, Integer>
Access to the crossing baselines of the alert evaluation. The rows are derived state, so nothing here is exposed over REST; they are read and written only by the evaluation itself.

  • Method Details

    • findByIdTenantAndIdAlgoStrategyAndIdSecuritycurrencyAndBoundKey

      Optional<AlgoAlertState> findByIdTenantAndIdAlgoStrategyAndIdSecuritycurrencyAndBoundKey(Integer idTenant, Integer idAlgoStrategy, Integer idSecuritycurrency, String boundKey)
      Loads the baseline of one bound. The four arguments are exactly the unique key UK_AlertState, so at most one row can match.
      Parameters:
      idTenant - owning tenant
      idAlgoStrategy - strategy the alert belongs to
      idSecuritycurrency - instrument the alert was evaluated against
      boundKey - which bound of the alert, for example LOWER, UPPER, MA, RSI_LOWER
      Returns:
      the stored baseline, or empty when this bound has never been evaluated

    • deleteByIdAlgoStrategy

      @Transactional @Modifying @Query("DELETE FROM AlgoAlertState s WHERE s.idAlgoStrategy = ?1") int deleteByIdAlgoStrategy(Integer idAlgoStrategy)
      Discards every baseline of one strategy. Used when a strategy is deactivated, so that reactivating it later cannot report a crossing that happened while the alert was off. Deleting a strategy needs no call: the foreign key cascades.
      Parameters:
      idAlgoStrategy - strategy whose baselines are dropped
      Returns:
      number of removed rows

    • deleteByIdAlgoStrategyAndIdSecuritycurrency

      @Transactional @Modifying @Query("DELETE FROM AlgoAlertState s WHERE s.idAlgoStrategy = ?1 AND s.idSecuritycurrency = ?2") int deleteByIdAlgoStrategyAndIdSecuritycurrency(Integer idAlgoStrategy, Integer idSecuritycurrency)
      Discards the baselines of one alert on one instrument. Used for a pair whose scope is switched off, which is narrower than the whole strategy because the same strategy can reach one instrument through an active path and another through a deactivated one.
      Parameters:
      idAlgoStrategy - the alert
      idSecuritycurrency - the instrument whose baselines are dropped
      Returns:
      number of removed rows
